pages.text: The mod's hive holds $(l)5 bees$() and $(l)8 combs$(). Every vanilla wood has its own; craft one with that wood's planks, or craft a hive with planks to change its wood. Vanilla bees can live in it and make plain honeycomb.

$(l)Honey level$() counts the combs inside, 0 to 8. The honeycomb window on the hive's side fills one cell per comb, bottom to top, and the front drips honey when it's full.$(br2)$(l)Comparator:$() placed against a hive, it gives a signal of 0 to 8, one per comb, so redstone can tell when a hive is full.
